info.name: ArgueBot v2 isolated acceptance workflow
info.description: Run only through scripts/test-v2-postman.mjs against a disposable workspace. Provider responses are simulated; service persistence, execution and API validation are real.

item.name: Refuse a request without a bearer token
Sign in as the default administrator

exec: pm.test('Signed in as a system administrator',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.principalType).to.equal('User');pm.expect(v.user.isAdmin).to.equal(true);});

pm.test('Unanimity and per-command delivery are explicit',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.consensusPolicy).to.equal('unanimous');pm.expect(v.maxParticipants).to.be.at.least(4);pm.expect(v.deliveryModes).to.include.members(['next_turn','interrupt_now']);});

item.name: Preview saved endpoint without a provider request

exec: pm.test('Explicit destinations and no resolved values',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.generationUrl).to.match(/[/]api[/]chat$/);pm.expect(v.discoveryUrl).to.match(/[/]api[/]tags$/);pm.expect(v.headerNames).to.have.length(0);pm.expect(v.queryNames).to.have.length(0);});

pm.test('Completion and tool round trip observed',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.state).to.equal('completed');pm.expect(v.completionVerified).to.equal(true);pm.expect(v.toolsVerified).to.equal(true);pm.expect(v.modelRevision).to.equal(1);});

item.name: Retry model check without another invocation

exec: pm.test('Names are unique without regard to case',()=>pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.equal('resource_exists'));
pm.test('History is newest first without bodies',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json();pm.expect(rows.map(x=>x.revision)).to.deep.equal([2,1]);rows.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.body).to.equal(''));});
pm.test('Revert is a new revision with the old body',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.revision).to.equal(3);pm.expect(v.body).to.include('1st');});
pm.test('Four frozen seats and separate orchestrator',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.participants).to.have.length(4);pm.expect(v.orchestrator.name).to.equal('Postman orchestrator');});

if(['agent_turn','interrupting'].includes(pm.response.json().state)){setTimeout(()=>{},50);pm.execution.setNextRequest('Inspect interrupted run');} else pm.test('Interruption pauses without consensus',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.state).to.equal('paused');pm.expect(v.outcome).not.to.equal('consensus');});

const v=pm.response.json();const count=Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('pollCount')||0)+1;pm.collectionVariables.set('pollCount',count);if(v.state!=='completed' && count<100){setTimeout(()=>{},100);pm.execution.setNextRequest('Wait for unanimous result');}else pm.test('Completed with consensus',()=>{pm.expect(v.state).to.equal('completed');pm.expect(v.outcome).to.equal('consensus');});

pm.test('Frozen policy and separate usage counters',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.policy.maxParticipantTurns).to.equal(40);pm.expect(v.policy.questionInstructions).to.equal('Probe rollout evidence.');pm.expect(v.usage.participantTurns).to.be.at.least(8);pm.expect(v.usage.orchestrationCalls).to.be.at.least(2);pm.expect(v.usage.estimatedInputTokens).to.be.above(0);});

pm.test('Every seat agreed on the final proposal',()=>{const v=pm.response.json()[0];pm.expect(v.agreements).to.have.length(4);pm.expect(new Set(v.agreements.map(x=>x.participantId)).size).to.equal(4);v.agreements.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.position).to.equal('agree'));});

pm.test('Original and summarized delivery remain distinct',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json();pm.expect(rows).to.have.length(2);rows.forEach(x=>pm.expect(new Set([...x.deliveredParticipantIds,...x.summarizedParticipantIds]).size).to.equal(4));pm.expect(rows.find(x=>x.pinned).deliveredParticipantIds).to.have.length(4);pm.expect(rows.find(x=>!x.pinned).summarizedParticipantIds).to.have.length(4);});

pm.test('Structured memory retains source hashes and parent lineage',()=>{const rows=pm.response.json();pm.expect(rows.length).to.be.at.most(25);const current=rows.find(x=>x.active);pm.expect(current.sections).to.have.length(7);pm.expect(current.parentSummaryIds.length).to.be.above(0);pm.expect(current.sources.map(x=>x.messageId)).to.deep.equal(current.sourceIds);current.sources.forEach(x=>pm.expect(x.digest).to.match(/^[a-f0-9]{64}$/));pm.collectionVariables.set('summarySourceId',current.sources[0].messageId);pm.collectionVariables.set('summarySourceDigest',current.sources[0].digest);});

pm.test('Master key changed without exposing material',()=>{const v=pm.response.json();pm.expect(v.activeKeyId).not.to.equal(pm.collectionVariables.get('activeKeyId'));pm.expect(v.reencryptedCredentials).to.equal(1);pm.expect(v.retainedKeyCount).to.equal(2);pm.expect(v).not.to.have.property('keys');});
